scenarios.name: Scenario 2
scenarios.title: Fields 1–8 (6 + 2 small)
scenarios.description: Each winter pitch split into three even fields running across it (Fields 1–6), plus the two small fields (Fields 7–8).
pros: Most refs get two games — Monday needs 5 refs instead of 7, and 4 of them get two games (Tuesday: 5 refs, each with two games)
Fields meet Northern NSW recommended sizes
More space = a slower-paced game with fewer tackles, more time for players to think on the ball and fewer close-range shots on goal
The fields feel more full, good for the atmosphere of feeling like a “complete” comp (e.g. compared to mixed teams coming down to an empty rec oval and playing in a small corner)
cons: Senior teams might alternate between waves (wave 1 this week, wave 2 next)
Different field size to what was communicated to some players
Fields don't get as much of a break (though there are fewer people per m²)
scenarios.fieldNote: Fields are chosen each week to keep the middle fields (2 and 5) free where possible, so the maps show one typical week (named on each night).
